## 3. Major Financial AI Company News

**2026-05-09 — Nvidia AI equity commitments exceed $40B**  
Source: [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/09/nvidia-has-already-committed-40b-to-equity-ai-deals-this-year/)  
TechCrunch, citing CNBC, reports Nvidia has committed more than $40B to AI equity deals in 2026, including a $30B OpenAI investment and multibillion-dollar deals involving Corning and IREN.  
**Why it matters:** The scale reinforces Nvidia’s role not just as supplier but as capital allocator in the AI buildout. It also keeps pressure on scrutiny of circular financing: Nvidia-backed firms may also be major Nvidia customers.
